experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing: GSM2361442: PRO-seq K562 NHS, replicate 1 Homo sapiens OTHER
study_title: Nucleotide-resolution maps of nascent RNA-synthesis in human K562 cells in optimal growth conditions and upon a 30-minute heat shock at 42°C
description: Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing: GSM2361442: PRO-seq K562 NHS, replicate 1 Homo sapiens OTHER
library_construction_protocol: After tretments, the cells were harvested by centrifugation, and washed twice with PBS. Nuclei were isolated and run-on reactions were performed with biotinylated nucleotides as described by Kwak H, Fuda NJ, Core LJ, Lis JT. Precise maps of RNA polymerase reveal how promoters direct initiation and pausing. Science 2013 Feb 22 339(6122):950-3. The libraries were generated using TruSeq small-RNA adaptors, amplified 11 cycles, gel-purified and size-selected to 140-350 bp fragments. The libraries were sequenced using HiSeq 2000 (Illumina).
